description: Set the name your public profile shows beside your username, which it does not change (your handle, its URL and its redirects stay as they are). Any script, emoji, punctuation and inner spacing; one line, at most 64 characters (code points: an emoji is one), no tab or other control character and no broken (unpaired surrogate) character. Saved with its ends trimmed; null, "" or nothing but whitespace clears it, and your profile shows @handle. No wallet confirmation and no rate: change it whenever you like. Answers your profile settings, the display name as saved among them; a refusal is the route's problem with its reason (too_long, shape), detail and fix. Signed in only: send your account's API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.

display_name.description: The name to show beside your username, e.g. "Ada Lovelace" (at most 64 characters); null or "" clears it

name: set_display_name
title: Set your display name
